name: Volunteer Page - Fall 2026 Roles
description: The volunteer page's roles section with the Fall 2026 volunteer sheet published: 'Volunteer roles open this fall', then the city roles first (SF / Bay Area, New York City, NYC × AI Events, Boston / Cambridge, London) and the team roles after them, with the four roles editors added earlier kept at the end. Every role signs up through the volunteer interest form; no contact names or volunteer details are published. A city role with no photo of its own shows its chapter's photo under a crimson wash, so NYC × AI Events shares the New York photo, and every other role without a photo shows the shared site photo, so no card is left blank. Those photos stay at Mobile, where the grid is one column. The hover only scrolls the section into view.
